summary: The installer grants the Samantha plugin OpenClaw's conversation-hook access (plugins.entries.openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui.hooks.allowConversationAccess=true) on every install, update and enable, so its agent_end, before_prompt_build, before_model_resolve and before_agent_run hooks are registered again.
reason: S24 28/10, Gateway log: OpenClaw 2026.9.6 reports 'typed hook "agent_end" | "before_prompt_build" | "before_model_resolve" | "before_agent_run" blocked because non-bundled plugins must set plugins.entries.openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui.hooks.allowConversationAccess=true' at every start. Effects observed on the S24 the same day: the native turn end never reached the Companion (10/10 owner WhatsApp turns left 'running' in runs.json), so the 30 s progress notice 'Je reviens vers toi.' was sent after almost every answer; the owner foundation hook (before_prompt_build) and conversation model profiles were not applied either. A diagnostic line in agent_end stayed silent across two real WhatsApp turns, and a direct native_end POST to the Companion closed the row, isolating the block to hook registration.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-plugin-install-noninteractive.sh
tests.evidence: Both the in-place update path and the first install path now set hooks.allowConversationAccess true; the test fails on the base lib.sh.

capabilities.reason: OpenClaw permission for hooks the plugin already registers; no capability, route or tool change.

architecture.reason: Same hooks and owners as designed in L2/L3/L4; only the OpenClaw grant that lets them register.

evidence: Gateway hooks only; MCP primitives unchanged.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Live proof: after the Companion restart applies the grant and the Gateway restarts, the log has no 'typed hook ... blocked' line and an owner WhatsApp turn closes without the progress notice.
Conversation access lets the plugin's hooks read turn messages; the hooks already transport no text (closed metadata only).
rollback: Revert this commit and run openclaw config unset plugins.entries["openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui"].hooks.allowConversationAccess, then restart the Gateway.
